title: macos: detect kitty terminal for hotkey and in-app spawns
body:
Closes #1125

On macOS, Kitty isn't detected as a known terminal emulator. Because Kitty does not set `TERM_PROGRAM` by default (it sets `KITTY_WINDOW_ID`, `KITTY_PID`, and `TERM=xterm-kitty`), `detect_macos_terminal()` falls through to `MacTerminalKind::Unk
